name: hero
description: Full-width hero banner with heading, supporting copy, and an optional call-to-action button. The reference component — copy its shape when adding new components.

subtitle.description: Supporting copy shown under the heading.

eyebrow.description: Small label rendered above the heading.

cta_label.description: Button text. The button renders only when both cta_label and cta_url are set.

alignment.description: Horizontal alignment of the hero content.
